docs.armsom.org/armsom-sige5 • V1.3 schematic, sheets 3 / 10 / 11 / 23. GPIO + common peripheral mux; all documented functions retained.
Mux availability depends on software and shared board functions. Pin 22 is SARADC, not a digital GPIO.
